expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol with request identifiers for correlating messages, timestamps for recording creation time, and explicit version information to support protocol-version negotiation while preserving the existing Ping roundtrip behavior.

Shipped: v2 Hello messages with the explicit `v:2|hello|<message>` envelope.
